name: eczid-mcp-trust
description: See what the MCP servers configured in a workspace expose: which servers are declared, how they launch, which environment key names look credential-shaped, and whether any ECZ-ID public proof reference exists. Inspection only: OBSERVED, never ENFORCED. Free.

interface.shortDescription: Review MCP servers in a repo
interface.longDescription: See what the MCP servers configured in a workspace expose: which servers are declared, how they launch, which environment key names look credential-shaped, whether a local policy or allowlist exists, and whether any ECZ-ID public proof reference is present. A local, filename-and-path-only review that reports EVIDENCE OBSERVED / NOT OBSERVED and a deterministic Review Priority. Inspection only: OBSERVED is not ENFORCED, and nothing here mediates traffic.
defaultPrompt: Review this workspace's MCP server configuration and report the Review Priority.
